dataset.title: Reduced polymerase pausing compensates for increased chromatin accessibility in the aging liver

findings.message: The bundle holds 44059 where the producer reported 43102 (results.txt: All target peptides with q-value <= 0.01). Both numbers are kept; treat the producer's as canonical until the difference is explained.

This multiplex search (MetaMorpheus 1.1.13) wrote its combined AllPeptides.psmtsv with each peptide's best PSM's PSM-level q-values, not peptide-level ones (MetaMorpheus #2941; QuantProject 071, corrected by v3.22). So `peptidoforms.best_q_value` and `best_q_value_notch` are PSM-level here, stored as written, and `peptidoforms_1pct` is a PSM-level filter: it passes more peptidoforms than results.txt's peptide-level count. The search's per-file _Peptides.psmtsv tables carry each file's own peptide-level q-values, which this bundle does not read; no file of this search gives a search-wide peptide-level q-value per peptide. `PeptideQuantification.tsv`'s values (DEF-TMT-PEP) are unaffected.

181 row(s) of PeptideQuantification.tsv carry no multiplex label, with 1313 value(s), stored as written. A peptide with no label gives no reporter ions of its own, so these values are co-isolated interference (QuantProject 066, rule 4); a protein group's value can include them. Leave them out of peptide-level statistics. MetaMorpheus is to stop quantifying them (QuantProject 068, ruling 1). E.g. `[Common Biological:Acetylation on X]AAAAASGAGGVAVAGAGGAGPAGR`, `[Common Biological:Acetylation on X]AAAATGLR`, `[Common Biological:Acetylation on X]AAAGSLER` and 178 more.
The search identified an unusually small fraction of the MS2 spectra. Treat absence of a protein in this dataset as weak evidence. Producer's note: 59035/421198 = 14.02% of MS2 identified (S3)

no SDRF says which sample is in which channel (no curated design and no deposited SDRF); PXReprise's default design makes each file its own plex and each channel its own sample; the reporter values compare nothing until a design is curated (QuantProject 079)

No SDRF was found for this dataset, so each channel's sample is the sample its search's TmtDesign.txt names (its `Sample Name`), with nothing else known about it. There is no sample metadata: treat every sample as unannotated.

Some modifications on peptides shared between proteins were not written to ptm_sites for one or more of those proteins, because the peptide could not be located in that protein's sequence and the producer's residue spans cannot be paired with its accessions. Of the (PSM, protein) pairs affected: 308 named a protein that does not contain the stored peptide -- typically a PSM ambiguous between peptide sequences (level 4 or 5), where this protein carries a different candidate than the first, which is the one stored. Sites on the other proteins of the same PSMs are written. Counts are in bundle.json under protein_databases.

16 of the 32 files were searched as acquired, not calibrated (their names in the search carry no `-calib`): `20201002LU1_Li_PT_DG_01_FS_70`, `20201002LU1_Li_PT_DG_02_FS_70`, `20201002LU1_Li_PT_DG_04_FS_70`, `20201002LU1_Li_PT_DG_05_FS_70`, `20201002LU1_Li_PT_DG_06_FS_70`, `20201002LU1_Li_PT_DG_08_FS_70`, `20201002LU1_Li_PT_DG_09_FS_70`, `20201002LU1_Li_PT_DG_10_FS_70`, `20201002LU1_Li_PT_DG_11_FS_70`, `20201002LU1_Li_PT_DG_12_FS_70` and 6 more. Their reporter values are the same kind of number; their identifications rest on uncalibrated precursor masses (QuantProject 066, rule 3).

PTM site occupancy was not stored: this is a TMT dataset, and MetaMorpheus computes intensity occupancy for label-free searches only; its count occupancy is per file, repeated on every channel (QuantProject DEF-OCC-INT). `ptm_stoichiometry` has no rows here because of that, not because no site was modified.

dataset.summary: PXD034564 is a DDA isobaric dataset (Mus musculus) with 32 runs, 320 samples and no enrichment step (whole proteome). It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.13. At 1% FDR the search reports 59,035 PSMs, 44,059 peptidoforms and 6,470 protein groups, and the repository holds 78,418 PTM sites for it. 9 open warnings about it are recorded.

organisms_are: `organisms` is the organism of the protein DATABASE the search used, not a statement about the samples. Sample annotation, where any exists, is in the catalog's `samples` and `sample_characteristics` tables.
